importantNote: KML line geometries are official source data, but the KML line names are 'Adsız yol'. Mapping those style groups to the app's existing routeId values is an inference from spatial alignment, not an explicit route-name field in the KML.

unassignedSegments.assignmentBasis: Approximately 80 m central connector; KML provides no route name and it cannot be safely assigned to a current route.
